experience.title: FiveAges
bullets: **First author** of **SKIP** (**CoRL 2026**): **event-preserving keyframe selection**, **sparse video generation**, and **action-conditioned interpolation** for embodied world models; **4.16x faster rollout**, **89.0% lower FVD** on LIBERO.
Built **FiveagesWAM, a real-time interactive world model**, combining sparse-frame inference with **historical-image memory** for **continuous prediction across video chunks**.

experience.title: GigaAI
bullets: **GigaBrain-0.7 co-author.** Trained **System 3 (5B World Value Model)**; designed the **last-frame visual subgoal** and **task-progress conditioning interface** for the action policy.

experience.title: Huawei Nanjing Research Center · Celia Team
bullets: Worked on **on-device LLM inference acceleration**: **speculative decoding**, **KV-cache** and **parallel-decoding** optimization, and **CUDA profiling with Nsight** to locate bottlenecks.

experience.title: 中科第五纪 · FiveAges
bullets: 以**第一作者**开展 **SKIP**（**CoRL 2026**）研究：针对具身世界模型逐帧稠密生成开销大的问题，提出**保留任务事件的关键帧选择**、**稀疏视频生成**与**动作条件插值**的稀疏到稠密范式，LIBERO 上相较密集基线**推理加速 4.16 倍**、**FVD 降低 89.0%**。
开发 **FiveagesWAM 实时交互式世界模型**：结合关键帧 / 稀疏帧推理与**历史图像记忆**，实现**跨视频块的连续预测**，面向实时交互场景。

experience.title: 极佳视界 · GigaAI
bullets: **GigaBrain-0.7 共同作者**。负责三系统架构中 **System 3（5B World Value Model）**的训练；设计面向动作策略的**末帧视觉 subgoal** 与**任务进展条件化接口**，为策略提供目标图像与任务进度信号。

experience.title: 华为南京研究所 · 小艺业务部
bullets: 参与**端侧大模型推理加速**：涉及**投机解码**、**KV cache** 与**并行解码**优化，并基于 **Nsight** 进行 **CUDA 性能分析**以定位瓶颈。
